correctness.rationale: Decisive scope contradiction in assigned RESULT.md Assumptions and scope: "The normal form and orbit classification hold over every field". In characteristic 3 with r=2, the genuine necessary equation 2Tu=0 forces Tu=0. A rank-one square-zero T has ker T=im T, so u not in ker T (one of the claimed orbit types) is impossible. The actual GL_2 orbit types are two for T=0 and two for rank-one T, total FOUR, versus the submitted even-r formula 2r+1=FIVE. The explicit T(x)=y, T(y)=0, u=x gives Tu=y≠0 and violates Rota–Baxter because 2Tu≠0. Independent GF2 exhaustive normal-form counts at r=1,2,3 support the char2-specific census, but cannot repair a universal statement. Surviving restricted theorem is correct; full corrected final files with guarded scientific changes were not prepared, so the unchanged original claim fails correctness and is not marked repaired.
